shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with live see-through open air and cross-level pawn AI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, incremental grids, and event-driven work.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics (user requirement), with two documented deviations: floor removal only drops things when the exposed terrain is open air, and bomb-punched rooftop holes are deferred.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; all sync handlers fail into shutdown, renderer fails open to opaque-below.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T1)
- LevelComp / LevelExtensions / LevelMapGen: unchanged core from T0 (pocket maps aligned 1:1, ground map comp is the column controller, parent.Tile set for real day/night + geology).
- Sky generation (GenStep_ABSkyTerrain): no roof below = open air (dontRender terrain, impassable, invisible); thick natural roof = mineable rock walls from shared geology blend (ABRockGen) under a thick rock roof, so mountains continue upward and can be quarried; thin natural roof = walkable rock rim; constructed roof = buildable rooftop terrain.
- See-below renderer (LevelRenderer + RenderPatches, Harmony):
  - MapDrawer.DrawMapMesh prefix: when viewing the sky map, draws the surface map's own cached section submeshes translated to y=-2.5 (under everything above, inside camera far plane at all zooms), skipping submeshes above y=2 (fog/overlays), then a translucent black dim quad at y=-0.25 (strength settable 0-80%).
  - DynamicDrawManager.DrawDynamicThings postfix: re-runs the surface map's dynamic draw with a global offset flag so pawns/projectiles below render live; DrawPos getters across all Thing subclasses carry a one-branch postfix that shifts results only while the flag is set. Toggleable in settings.
  - Air cells render nothing (dontRender), so the offset content shows through; sky map stays fully live via the lower map's MapMeshDrawerUpdate_First each frame.
- Live cross-level sync (LevelSync, pure MapEvents subscriptions, zero Harmony):
  - Ground RoofChanged: roof gained -> air above becomes rooftop (buildable area expands live); roof lost -> floors above collapse via RemoveTopLayer, rooftop reverts to air.
  - Sky TerrainChanged: terrain becomes air -> cell contents drop to the surface (pawns take 9 blunt + short stun, items GenPlace near, buildings destroyed with debris raining through, stairwells destroyed with a message); constructed floor placed -> constructed roof written on the surface below if unroofed.
  - Sky ThingSpawned: anything spawning over open air falls through (deferred one frame). Exclusions: mineables, blueprints, frames, explosions, stairwells.
  - Subscriptions made in LevelComp.FinalizeInit (gen + load), removed in MapRemoved.
- Stairs / job / hotkeys / camera: unchanged from T0.

## Quadruple pass log (T1)
Verified: event reentrancy terminates on every chain; generation-window safety; perf gates. Known quirks: lower pawns' far-zoom silhouettes can draw over sky terrain; water-depth submeshes below may look flat. Deferred: bomb holes in rooftops, natural-roof-removal handling under sky mountains, below-glow rendering.
Confidence: static below-view 82%, live pawns below 80%, air holes 90%, sync 90%, sky stone 90%, fall-through 85%.

## Tranche plan
- T0 DONE. T1 CODE DONE (awaiting in-game verification).
- T1.1 (if test shows need): renderer polish (water depth, glow below, bomb holes).
- T2: movement: stair graph, cross-level pathing, drafted moves, pawns auto-use stairs for jobs, non-surface stair placement.
- T3: logistics: cross-map stockpiles/hauling (user-requested, next after T1 sign-off), storage, bills across levels.
- T4: systems: temperature/weather sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling.

## Status
T1 compiled green, pushed. Pending in-game test: see-below view, live roof sync, mountain stone.
